activity.notes: ATLAS separates Rodríguez de Francia's constitutionally distinct stages of rule rather than representing 1813–1840 as one undifferentiated dictatorship.

sources.title: Ministros de Hacienda y sedes históricas — Gobierno del Paraguay
sources.citation_text: The Paraguayan government chronology situates Rodríguez de Francia's consulship and successive dictatorship phases in the 1813–1840 consolidation of independent Paraguay.

sources.title: Rodríguez de Francia, José Gaspar — Archivo Nacional de Asunción
sources.citation_text: The Paraguayan National Archive authority record identifies José Gaspar Rodríguez de Francia and his governing offices in independent Paraguay.
